product.name: After-sales
product.description: Return, warranty, exchange and refund-request claims for anything a website sells — goods, rentals, services or subscriptions: eligibility windows by claim type, item type, grade or order snapshot (rules@1), required evidence and photos in the merchant's own bucket, a staff queue with statuses, transitions, notes and assignments, refunds published to the Orders ledger, per-line restock exactly once, a serial registry with a public warranty lookup and a customer–staff conversation through the merchant's messaging. Drop-in, headless or API; all data in the merchant's own database.

elements.name: Claims
elements.description: Purchases eligible for after-sales (from order events or the API), claim types, reasons and windows as data (days from delivery per type, item type, grade or order snapshot, rules@1 overrides), required evidence (details, serial, photos), and the customer claim form: signed-in customers (SS-Identity) or guests with a signed claim token see only their own claims.

elements.name: Evidence photos
elements.description: Claim photos uploaded straight to the merchant's own bucket through presigned uploads with a signed content length, HEAD-checked before they are attached. Metered per attached photo.

elements.name: Queue
elements.description: The staff queue: statuses, transitions and their kinds as data, internal notes, assignments, SLA due times and the full history of every claim.

elements.name: Refunds
elements.description: Full or partial refunds on a claim with method, reference, note and actor, capped by what was claimed, published as order.refunded@1 for the Orders ledger.

elements.name: Restock
elements.description: Per-line restock decisions once the item is back, applied exactly once per line, published as inventory.changed@1 or recorded for your own stock system.

elements.name: Serial registry
elements.description: Units by serial number across orders (from the Orders product's serial events or the API) with a lookup: the merchant sees order and claims, the public warranty lookup only the item and its cover.

elements.name: Messages
elements.description: The conversation between customer and staff on a claim, with notifications (new messages, status changes, new claims) through the merchant's own messaging connector.

plans.name: Starter
plans.description: Claims with windows and evidence and the staff queue; photos, refunds, restock, the serial registry and messages as add-ons.

plans.name: Pro
plans.description: Everything: evidence photos, refunds to the ledger, restock, the serial registry and customer messages.
